game_title: Infinite Loop Trap – Collapsed Passage Streak
game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Shadow Cave – Collapsed Passage, a half-collapsed passage: the lantern keeper must handle glow-eyed lurkers while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Infinite Loop Trap: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before glow-eyed lurkers overload Collapsed Passage.
theme: Shadow Cave – Collapsed Passage: a half-collapsed passage
core_gameplay_loop: In Collapsed Passage, repeat each round: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before glow-eyed lurkers overload Collapsed Passage. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the loop_safety value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about loop_safety to power up the lantern keeper and open the lantern post.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 5 (applied tier): Infinite Loop Trap
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

code_snippet:
while n < 5:
    print(n)  # n never changes
tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how loop_safety changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against glow-eyed lurkers in Collapsed Passage.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 9.
